Vendored MindEyeV2 runtime sources used by `avid_benchmark.models.mindeye2`.

This directory keeps the small subset of the authors' adapted MindEyeV2 snapshot that the
MindEye2 adapter import at runtime:

- `models.py`, `utils.py`, and `modeling_git.py`
- `autoencoder/convnext.py`
- `generative_models/` code, configs, and licenses

Large demo assets, notebooks, figures, git history, and Python caches are not
required here. The source copy came from `https://github.com/MedARC-AI/MindEyeV2`
at commit `c184718`.
